title: D2 agent output (d2-subtopic-picker)
description: Section 12/D2 'Agent output' line and .claude/agents/d2-subtopic-picker.md's worked output shape: {"subtopic_ids": [...] | ["unsure"], "why": str, "confidence": high|medium|low}. Created as part of the D1-D4 runner-plugin build (2026-10), replacing the empty placeholder schema file. Cross-referencing ids against the real (draft or approved) subtopic list(s) given to the agent lives in scripts/checks/D2.py, same split as D1.

subtopic_ids.description: One or two real subtopic ids from the chapter's (or two chapters', for a D1 two-chapter question) subtopic list, or exactly ["unsure"]. A second id only when the question truly compares or combines them.

note.description: Optional, same real-bug fix as schemas/D1.json's own note field -- Universal rule 7 applies to every agent including this one even though d2-subtopic-picker.md's own worked example doesn't show it. See the build report.

oneOf.description: Universal rule 8: if the input file is missing or broken, the agent writes only {"error": "..."}.
